target_customer: Companies running latency sensitive voice agents, and developers wanting cheap coding model access
problem: Voice agents need very low latency inference across speech to text, language model and text to speech. Hopper tunes and serves open models on customers' production calls.
business_model: Usage-based inference and post-training services; the company site also sells monthly coding plans from 20 to 200 dollars

founders.name: Pavan Katta
founders.background_notes: Ran voice inference at Salient per the YC page.

founders.name: Jashwanth Pedapudi
founders.background_notes: Kernels engineer writing inference kernels for Quest 3.

competitors.name: Cartesia
competitors.what: Low latency text to speech models (Sonic)
competitors.traction_then: Sonic Turbo about 40ms time to first audio per a roundup

competitors.name: Deepgram
competitors.what: Streaming speech to text and Flux TTS with latency as low as 80ms

competitors.name: LiveKit Inference
competitors.what: Model gateway built for voice AI

technical_complexity.rationale: Custom inference kernels and tuning of speech models to hit tens of milliseconds latency; founders have kernel and voice inference backgrounds.

defensibility.rationale: Post-training on customer calls could create data advantage, but providers like Together, Cerebras and Deepgram compete on latency and speed gains can be copied.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Not yet known; incumbents were shipping low latency voice inference in 2026.

market_need_then: Growth of voice agents in 2026 with latency as a key complaint; Salient's 60M dollar Series A (per the YC page) indicates the sector's funding.

branding.domain_note: Uses withhopper.com because the travel company Hopper owns the shorter name
branding.community_and_virality: Site claims use by developers in 44 countries

brand_strength.rationale: Name collides with the well known travel app Hopper; no brand press found.

outcome_analysis: Hopper is a two person F26 company from IIT Madras founders with voice inference experience, selling latency optimized open model inference for voice agents. Competition from Deepgram, Cartesia and gateways is strong and funding is undisclosed. No outcome events found.
notes: Dealroom lists a 125K seed (one paywalled aggregator, unverified, not recorded). Funding cross-check found nothing else. The company site currently emphasizes a coding plan product (DeepSeek served for coding agents), which differs from the YC voice inference description; no date for the shift.
